requests.name: Step 1 - Login & Obtain CSRF Token
requests.description: Step 1: authenticate with your Central username/password to obtain a session cookie + CSRF token used by step 2.

requests.name: Step 2 - Obtain Authorization Code
requests.description: Step 2: exchange the session + CSRF token for a one-time authorization code (scope=all).

requests.name: Step 3 - Acquire the Access Token
requests.description: Step 3: exchange the authorization code for the short-lived Bearer access_token. Paste that token into the {{arubaToken}} variable used by every request below.

requests.name: Refresh Access Token
requests.description: Exchange a refresh_token for a fresh short-lived access token when {{arubaToken}} expires. Re-paste the new token into {{arubaToken}}.
